shortDescription: Create or Delete OSPF configuration on AOS-CX

options.name: area_id
options.description: OSPF Area Identifier, in X.X.X.X form, or as a number in [0, 4294967295].

options.name: ipsec_ah
options.description: IPsec Authentication Header configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both ipsec_ah and ipsec_esp are configured.

options.name: ipsec_esp
options.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. Specifies SPI, encryption/authentication type, and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec ESP if both ipsec_ah and ipsec_esp are configured.

options.name: ospf_auth_keychain
options.description: Name of the "Keychain" used for cryptographic authentication. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512.

options.name: ospf_auth_md5_keys
options.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type md5 message-digest.

options.name: ospf_auth_sha_keys
options.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type sha.

options.name: ospf_auth_text_key
options.description: The authentication key for OSPFv2 authentication type "text".

options.name: ospf_auth_type
options.description: The type of OSPFv2 authentication. If not set, then the area level authentication of the transit area holds for the port.

options.name: ospf_id
options.description: The OSPF Router the Area will belong to once created

options.name: peer_router_id
options.description: Id of the Peer Router in IPv4 (X.X.X.X) format.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or update or delete the Interface.

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF the OSPF Area will belong to once created. If the OSPF Area is created and the user wants to change its VRF, the user must first delete the OSPF Area, and then recreate it in the desired VRF.
